rationale: Ahmad brings deep hardware expertise from Vision Pro and Leap Motion—spatial computing and hand-tracking systems—while Weiru's background in creator-focused product marketing at ByteDance represents the consumer-facing, content-first ecosystem where next-gen AI hardware interfaces will actually be adopted. They're on opposite ends of the AI hardware value chain: Ahmad is architecting the device, Weiru understands how creators and audiences will actually use it.
intro_message: Ahmad Abbas, meet Weiru @Creative Community — Ahmad's pioneering AI-native hardware at Midjourney could benefit from Weiru's expertise in how creators at ByteDance adopt and engage with new form factors.
